name: メールアプリを開く回復案内
prompt: Create only the compact mobile component in the exact 390:328 aspect ratio. White background with no pale green wash, no phone or device frame, status/navigation chrome, footer, back control, branding, added icons or copy. Use the original reference for the small green outlined circle/check success symbol and button anatomy; use the Japanese mock for crop, layout, exact copy and wrapping. Center the outlined forest-green success circle and check near the top, then the heading 「再設定メールを送信しました」 and body 「新しいパスワードを設定する手順を送信しました。受信箱を確認してください。メールが見つからない場合はサポートへご連絡ください。」. Place a full-width rounded forest-gradient primary action with white text 「メールアプリを開く」; use gradient #174C36 0%, #1F6444 58%, #2D8F5E 100%. Below it, place a white secondary action with restrained neutral outline and dark text 「メールを再送」. Keep comfortable compact spacing and the same centered hierarchy. Use Meiryo Bold 20/28 for heading and Meiryo Regular 14/24 for body, with clear Japanese glyphs. Output only this component on pure white.
reviewNotes: Parent approved exact candidate; see private digest-bound approval.
